question.text: A brokerage firm wants to trade IRD for both proprietary and client accounts, without algorithmic trading. What is the required BMC?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook BMC table, proprietary plus client trading without algo requires Rs. 25 lacs. The tiers are: only proprietary, no algo — Rs. 10 lacs; only client, no algo — Rs. 15 lacs; proprietary plus client, no algo — Rs. 25 lacs; all brokers with algo — Rs. 50 lacs. The Trap: Rs. 50 lakhs applies to all brokers with algo, not to the no-algo prop-plus-client tier. Rs. 75 lakhs and Rs. 1 crore are not categories in the source table. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), pages 289-290 (BMC table).
